messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — customer (regulated fintech) asking if we can run a POC in a fully locked-down data center. Main asks: offline installer, signed bundles, certificate rotation cadence, and how upgrades/patch windows work for air-gapped installs. Need rough answer + risks by EOD.

sam_eng: We can do it, but details matter. Two common routes: a) full offline bundle (signed tar with all images + checksums) b) minimal bootstrap image that pulls deltas from a staging mirror. Both need signing and SBOM.

bob_devops: Agree. For POCs I'd recommend the full offline bundle for first delivery — simpler ops. Patch cadence depends on customer SLAs. We usually recommend monthly security-only patches + quarterly feature bundles for on-prem customers.

maria_sales: customer asking about 'hotfixes' between bundles — can we do signed hotpatches?

sam_eng: Yes, we can ship signed delta patches. They have to be applied in a strict order; we also include a migration-check script. Example check command we give to customers:
```
./redwood-cli verify --bundle /path/to/bundle.tar.gz 
# returns exit 0 if signatures and checksums match and prechecks pass
```

bob_devops: Important: for true air-gapped installs we need an operator on-site to run the bundle. We can provide an automation script, but it needs network-disabled testing.

amy_legal: Quick flag: encryption of the bundle at rest + signing key custody. Customer asked that private keys be HSM-backed. We need to confirm if they require customer-managed keys.

jen_se: From SE side: we'll provide a POC runbook. Key pieces: install steps, verify script, rollback steps, and a list of kernel/OS prerequisites. Also include offline KMS integration doc if they want to bring their own KMS.

maria_sales: Pricing Q: for an air-gapped POC, do we bill setup time/packaging separately? They expect a POC to be included but also want support SLA during the window.

bob_devops: We usually include one standard POC packaging in sales credits. Anything custom (custom installers, signed with customer key, extended on-site support) is billable. Estimate: 2–4 engineering days for packaging + 1 day of on-site assist if requested.

amy_legal: Also call out export control and restricted components in SBOM — legal will review SBOM before we ship.

sam_eng: Ops constraints: offline upgrades mean we can't rely on runtime telemetry. Suggest adding a lightweight telemetry export that the customer can push out-of-band, or we accept reduced observability for POC. Also keep KV cache sizes small if they want small image footprint.

maria_sales: Can someone draft a short customer-facing paragraph I can send now? Need to include upgrade cadence, who runs upgrades, and signing/key custody.

jen_se: Draft below — feel free to copy: 
"For air-gapped POCs we deliver a signed, checksummed offline bundle that an on-site operator installs. By default Redwood provides monthly security-only patches and quarterly feature bundles. We can provide signed delta hotfixes for urgent issues. Bundle signing can be Redwood-managed or integrated with your HSM/KMS for customer-managed keys (additional engineering time required). The POC includes a runbook and verification tooling; extended on-site support or custom packaging is billable."

maria_sales: Perfect — I'll send that. Two final asks: 1) can we commit to a maximum time to produce a signed bundle (estimate?) 2) what's the rollback story if a patch fails?

sam_eng: Estimate: 3 business days for standard bundle prep and verification; 5–7 days if customer HSM integration + legal SBOM review. Rollback: we ship bundles as immutable snapshots. The runbook includes a verify step before applying; if apply fails, we have a staged rollback to previous snapshot and DB migration reversal where applicable. We test rollback during POC.

bob_devops: Add-on: if they want automatic patch orchestration we can offer a 'staged-update-plan' that does canary apply to a subset of nodes, but that requires networked mirrors. Not available for fully sealed installs.

maria_sales: Thanks all. I'll send copy and attach runbook draft. @amy_legal please start SBOM review when I share. @sam_eng can you confirm the 3-day estimate by EOD? :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Note: created ticket INF-POC-4883 for "Air-gapped POC packaging + HSM request" assigned to sam_eng. ETA: TBD.

sam_eng: Confirmed 3 business days for standard bundle. If they sign up for HSM integration we'll adjust estimate.

amy_legal: Acknowledged — will watch for SBOM.

maria_sales: Sending to customer now. I'll paste thread updates if they reply. :rocket:
